purpose: Design or implement firmware under real timing, memory, hardware and recovery constraints.
route_when: The task changes MCU firmware, hardware interaction, timing or control behavior.
do_not_route_when: The task is generic software without embedded constraints.
non_goals: Flash or actuate hardware without approval
risk_limits: Hardware control is E6 and needs explicit approval plus recovery plan.
runtime_constraints: Prefer non-blocking, bounded and watchdog-safe behavior.
